description: Resources curated by Unity Nodes validators (moved here from unityhub.dev/celestia): endpoints, explorers, monitoring, services, tools, faucets, articles, videos and learning material for node operators (page validator), builders (developers), the community and people learning about Celestia (education). Called with no arguments it lists every page and section with its size; pass page and section to read one, network to keep one network, query to find words in labels, titles, descriptions and URLs. What a linked page says about itself is third-party text and is fenced. For peers, seeds and snapshots of the live network use get_celestia_operator_toolkit.

network.description: Only resources for this network (and those for both).

page.description: validator: node operators; developers: building on Celestia; community; education: learning material.

query.description: Words to find in labels, groups, titles, descriptions and URLs.

section.description: A section slug from the overview, e.g. endpoints, explorers, monitoring, services, articles, videos.

name: list_celestia_resources
